compiler: Clang/LLVM from Ubuntu 26.04 package repository; exact package versions captured in build logs. Python 3 is installed inside the image for native-metric summary generation, with its package version captured alongside the compiler.
build: pjproject configure + make dep + make; compile libraries with libFuzzer-no-link and AddressSanitizer instrumentation.
engine: LLVM libFuzzer linked into the upstream fuzz-sip target.
coverage_reporting: libFuzzer cov/ft feature counts and corpus growth; no AFLNet stability, bitmap, server readiness, or queue network replay metrics.
